description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><p>We’re looking for an experienced <strong>Analytics Manager </strong>to join Wolt in<strong> Berlin, Stockholm, Helsinki, or London</strong>!</p> <h2>About the Marketing Analytics team</h2> <p>In the Marketing Analytics team, we are focused on improving the effectiveness of our marketing spend and boosting Wolt’s growth. We work across a broad set of marketing questions, helping teams understand what is working, where to invest, and how to improve marketing performance across Wolt. We partner with Marketing, Product, and Strategy &amp; Operations teams closely to guide measurement and tactical decision-making using advanced analytics. Considering the scale of Wolt’s marketing function, there are many exciting problems to be solved and plenty of opportunities to make a business impact!</p> <p>You’ll be part of this team working with top Data Science and Analytics Engineering professionals. As we grow the next level of maturity in Marketing Analytics, you’ll help shape the roadmap, develop the team, and build the operating rhythm that turns analysis into better business decisions.</p> <h2>What you’ll be doing</h2> <p>As an Analytics Manager at Wolt, you are essential in revolutionizing our marketing strategies. You’ll define the analytics roadmap for the team, prioritize the most important business questions, and ensure the work leads to clear decisions and follow-through. Acting as a critical partner to senior business and product leaders, this role will drive the Marketing domain forward, shaping the future of our initiatives.</p> <p>Key responsibilities include defining and monitoring key performance indicators to gauge the effectiveness of innovative marketing initiatives. The role offers an exciting opportunity to brainstorm 0-to-1 growth investment opportunities and establish the foundation for our marketing investment framework. You’ll lead, coach, and develop a team of Data Scientists, helping them stay close to the business and deliver work that improves marketing decisions and outcomes.</p> <p>Success in this role requires exceptional leadership and project management skills, along with strong communication and interpersonal abilities. Collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams will be crucial in fostering a culture of shared success and innovation. This position offers a thrilling opportunity to shape the future of growth at Wolt!</p> <h2>Our humble expectations</h2> <ul> <li><strong>6+ years of experience</strong> in a Data Analytics or Data Science position, with <strong>2+ years of leadership experience</strong>.</li> <li>Experience in<strong> leading large teams (5-10 direct reports)</strong></li> <li>Prior experience in hiring and mentoring skilled members for your data science teams.</li> <li>Expertise with SQL and statistical analysis using Python, R, or equivalent.</li> <li>Strong understanding of <strong>experimentation, attribution, media mix modeling, and marketing measurement concepts</strong>, with a pragmatic approach to applying them to business decisions.</li> <li>Clear communication and strong business partnership skills, with a track record of turning analytical work into decisions, actions, and measurable impact.</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer</h2> <ul> <li>The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics!</li> <li>You can choose the location from our tech hubs in Berlin, London, Helsinki or Stockholm. You have the chance to decide the ways of working: hybrid, at the office, or remote within Germany, the UK, Finland or Sweden. 💙</li> <li>You would get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognize that if we don’t learn, we won’t stay still but fall behind and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda’s greatest achievement.</li> </ul> <h2>Next steps</h2> <p>The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!</p> <p>For any further questions about the position, you can turn to Senior Talent Acquisition Partner - Zhanna Filintseva via <a ---------- <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/Ncz4s_oBczc" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.</span></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

  • You'll test broadly at first, product-led growth, organic and AI search, email, social, events, content, paid, but the goal is to find the two or three channels that actually work and go deep on those rather than running a wide portfolio indefinitely.

About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  3. Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role:

The Enterprise Risk Analyst will play a crucial role in identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating risks across the organisation. This position supports the continuous evolution of the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework, ensuring that potential threats to our strategic objectives, operations, finances, and reputation are proactively managed. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, a keen eye for detail, and the ability to communicate complex risk concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders. Some key components of the role are as follows

  • Support the identification of potential risks (e.g., operational, financial, strategic, compliance, technological, reputational, environmental) across all business units and functions..

  • Assist in conducting comprehensive risk assessments, including qualitative and quantitative analysis, to evaluate the likelihood and impact of identified risks.

  • Facilitate risk workshops and discussions with various departments to gather risk intelligence

  • Leverage automation and AI to enhance efficiency and reduce risk where applicable.

This role demands a knack for collaborating with all levels of stakeholders, rapidly grasping new business domains, and forging balanced solutions that foster growth within defined risk parameters

Your team’s objectives

  • Embed and maintain the Risk Management Framework to establish a clear, consistent, and comprehensive approach to risk management across the enterprise..

  • To collaborate with business functions with the objective to effectively manage the firm's risks.

  • To provide independent review and challenge where necessary to mitigate the chance of the firm not meeting its overall obligations


What you’ll be doing/impact on objectives

  • Support the successful deployment and ongoing use of a new Risk Management System.

  • Collaborate with business units to ensure timely completion and review of risk assessments

  • Develop and communicate regular KRI reports, collaborating with business SMEs to provide insightful commentary that enhances risk understanding

  • Collaborate with business units to ensure the timely completion of actions originating from the Enterprise Risk Function.

  • Assess and validate the effectiveness of established controls

  • Provide oversight of the risk event and risk acceptance processes, delivering insightful analysis to the business.

  • Assist with the end-to-end risk event process, including reviewing, escalation, and resolution of risk events to drive continuous improvement.

What we’re looking for

  • Proven experience in the financial services sector, with a strong understanding of industry best practices relating to Risk or Second Line activities

  • Educated to degree level or holding a relevant compliance qualification

  • Possesses a strong work ethic, sound judgment, and the ability to make well-informed decisions.

  • Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal.

  • Comprehensive knowledge or willingness to learn about regulations and development embedding of an enterprise risk framework

The interview process

We’re not a corporation so we try our best to get things moving as quickly as possible. For this role we’d expect:

  • Online Cognitive Assessment (15 min)

  • Chat with a Recruiter (15 min)

  • Introduction Call with the Enterprise Risk Manager (30 min)

  • Case study interview (60 min)

  • Culture interview with the Director of Enterprise Risk (45 min in-person)

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our blog!

Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like SKIMS, Figma, Riot Games, Anthropic, Spotify and Puma are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations.

We’re looking for a nordics speaker who has built and closed net-new enterprise business in complex technical products, has a track record of consistently exceeding growth goals, and can turn what they learn about a customer into an account plan the whole team can act on. Clear communication, an entrepreneurial mindset, and real curiosity about where your customers' industries are heading matter more to us than a perfect résumé match.

What will you do:

You'll grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts, and a lot of that growth is net-new: new teams, new use cases, new business units that haven't bought Sanity yet. You'll build your own pipeline rather than wait for one, and you'll be the advisor customers come to before they make a decision.

That means running consultative sales cycles end to end, creating expansion opportunities inside existing accounts, and handling renewals as part of a wider growth story rather than the main event. You'll show ROI to the exec who signs and to the editor who's in Studio every day.

You will also:

  • Keep account plans current, with clear next steps tied to customer and company goals.

  • Work with Product and other teams to surface opportunities and resolve problems before they escalate.

  • Watch customer health and usage metrics, and act early rather than at renewal.

  • Follow your customers' industries closely enough to have a point of view.

About you:

You've sold net-new into enterprise organisations where a deal involves procurement, security review and several teams who all need convincing, and you've done it by sourcing and building your own pipeline. You can point to results on revenue, expansion and account growth. You know how to find the right decision-maker, earn executive buy-in, and build relationships that outlast any single deal.

You're thoughtful and consultative. You read usage data and turn it into a conversation about business value. Architecture with a technical lead in one meeting, ROI with a CFO in the next.

You also bring:

  • Ideally previously expertise in CMS, or experience selling API-based solutions in SaaS, CPaaS, or PaaS.

  • Clear written and verbal communication.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Looker and G-Suite.

  • You'll be fluent in either Norwegian or Swedish

  • An entrepreneurial mindset: hands-on, creative, team-oriented, and happier building a process than waiting for one.

Not sure you’re exactly what we’re looking for in this role? Apply anyway!


What we can offer:

  • A highly-skilled, inspiring, and supportive team

  • Positive, flexible, and trust-based work environment that encourages long-term professional and personal growth

  • A global, multi-culturally diverse group of colleagues and customers

  • Comprehensive health plans and perks

  • A healthy work-life balance that accommodates individual and family needs

  • Competitive salary and stock options program

Who we are:

Sanity.io is a modern, flexible content operating system that replaces rigid legacy content management systems. One of our big differentiators is treating content as data so that it can be stored in a single source of truth, but seamlessly adapted and personalized for any channel without extra effort. Forward-thinking companies choose Sanity because they can create tailored content authoring experiences, customized workflows, and content models that reflect their business.

Sanity recently raised a $85m Series C led by GP Bullhound and is also backed by leading investors like ICONIQ Growth, Threshold Ventures, Heavybit and Shopify, as well as founders of companies like Vercel, WPEngine, Twitter, Mux, Netlify and Heroku. This funding round has put Sanity in a strong position for accelerated growth in the coming years.

You can only build a great company with a great culture. Sanity is a 200+ person company with highly committed and ambitious people. We are pioneers, we exist for our customers, we are hel ved, and we love type two fun! Read more about our values here!

Sanity.io pledges to be an organization that reflects the globally diverse audience that our product serves. We believe that in addition to hiring the best talent, a diversity of perspectives, ideas, and cultures leads to the creation of better products and services. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of space-powered Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are fundamentally changing the design, economics, manufacturing, coverage limitations and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems.
 
By building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system—with a unique antenna design, highly sustainable spacecraft system and low-cost, small portable end-user devices—we can extend global satellite coverage, capacity and connectivity beyond legacy space services to provide a new kind of IoT platform that lets users sense, track, connect and act on information gathered, anywhere.
 
We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to saving space, protecting our planet and turning connectivity into actionable intelligence.

We are looking for a talented and experienced Senior Digital Hardware Design Engineer to join our hardware engineering team. You will play a key role in the design, development, and delivery of complex digital hardware solutions for high-performance products. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will take ownership of designs from concept through to production, driving technical excellence across the full development lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement digital hardware including high-speed interfaces, signal processing, and switching/routing architectures.
  • Develop, simulate, and verify RTL designs, ensuring correctness, timing closure, and design robustness.
  • Define and review hardware architectures, contributing to system-level design decisions and trade-off analyses.
  • Produce and review detailed design documentation, including specifications, schematics, and test plans.
  • Perform functional simulation, static timing analysis, and synthesis targeting FPGAs and/or ASICs.
  • Collaborate with firmware, software, and systems engineers to ensure seamless hardware/software integration.
  • Support hardware verification and validation activities, including lab bring-up and debugging.
  • Contribute to design reviews, code reviews, and continuous improvement of engineering processes
  • Collaborate with manufacturing teams to ensure seamless design for high volume manufacture and test
  • Work with component manufacturers and distributors to ensure longevity of manufacture.
  • Experience with Altium Designer
  • Design principles for operation in harsh environments.

Required Skills & Experience
  • Degree (BEng/MEng/BSc or equivalent) in Electronic Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline
  • Solid understanding of digital design fundamentals including clocking strategies, CDC (clock domain crossing), reset architecture, and timing constraints.
  • Experience with FPGA design flows using tools such as Vivado, Quartus, or equivalent.
  • Familiarity with simulation tools such as ModelSim, Questa, or similar.
  •  Experience writing and executing hardware test plans and debug at the board level using lab equipment (oscilloscopes, logic analysers, protocol analysers).
  • Strong understanding of high-speed PCB design considerations and signal integrity principles.

Desirable Skills
  • Five or more years experience with high speed digital design.
  • Experience with Altium Designer
  • Experience with Hyperlynx
  • Accelerated life testing

Frontier is an independent video game developer and publisher, crafting immersive gaming experiences with fun gameplay and unparalleled artistic quality. Renowned for its iconic creative management simulation games, Frontier captivates players worldwide with immersive and authentic game worlds. The modern studio is located in the vibrant technology hub of Cambridge (UK). The talented team at Frontier are dedicated to nurturing our existing portfolio and delivering our exciting future roadmap. 
 
This role is offered on a full in-studio basis or a hybrid basis (minimum 3 days per week in the studio). We can provide a comprehensive relocation support package as part of any offer, should you need to relocate. 

WHAT’S THE ROLE?

We’re looking for a highly experienced Principal Concept Artist to help define and elevate the visual direction of our projects.

In this role, you’ll sit at the forefront of creative development, combining exceptional artistic skill with strategic thinking and leadership. You’ll play a key role in shaping the look and feel of our worlds, working closely with Art Direction and cross‑disciplinary teams to deliver compelling, high‑quality visual experiences.


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
  • Define and guide the creation of high-quality concept art across key content areas, including characters, environments, props, and visual storytelling elements.  
    • Work closely with the Art Director to interpret and extend the project’s visual vision, translating it into clear, actionable concept direction.
      • Act as the primary concept point of contact within the project, ensuring alignment between Art Direction and concept delivery.  
        • Lead and support the concept team within the project, providing clear direction, feedback, and guidance to ensure consistent, high-quality output.
          • Mentor and develop artists at all levels, supporting progression, capability building, and leadership growth where appropriate.
            • Take creative briefs and explore a wide range of visual solutions, refining them into strong, production-ready directions.
              • Establish and communicate clear visual targets, benchmarks, and supporting material to guide concept artists and downstream teams.
                • Break down high-level creative direction into modular, production-ready concepts aligned with modelling, animation, design, and implementation requirements.
                  • Provide high-level feedback across teams, ensuring clarity, consistency, and alignment of concept work across all areas.
                    • Collaborate closely with design, production, and other art disciplines to ensure concept work supports gameplay, narrative, and technical constraints.
                      • Represent the concept discipline in project planning, reviews, and cross-team discussions, supporting alignment and decision-making.
                        • Support planning, scoping, and prioritisation of concept work in collaboration with Production and project leadership, ensuring alignment with delivery needs.
                          • Contribute hands-on concept work where appropriate to establish quality benchmarks and resolve complex visual challenges.
                            • Support teams in managing outsourced concept work, ensuring clear direction, effective feedback, and alignment with project standards.
                              • Identify and contribute to improvements in workflows, pipelines, documentation, and discipline practices, supporting efficiency, clarity, and quality across the project.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating expert-level concept design across multiple disciplines and styles.
    • Significant experience in senior or leadership-level concept art roles within the games industry.
      • Exceptional artistic skill, with deep understanding of anatomy, composition, perspective, lighting, and visual storytelling.
        • Proven ability to translate high-level artistic vision into clear, actionable concept direction.
          • Strong understanding of how concept art supports modelling, design, gameplay, and narrative.
            • Experience guiding and supporting teams to deliver high-quality concept work.
              • Demonstrated ability to provide clear, constructive feedback that improves quality and clarity of output.
                • Experience mentoring and developing artists, including supporting progression and capability building.
                  • Experience acting as a key point of contact or leading concept direction within a project.
                    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence across disciplines.
                      • Strong problem-solving ability, able to resolve complex creative and production challenges.
                        • Experience working with outsourcing pipelines and supporting teams with external partners.

BONUS IF YOU HAVE
  • Experience working on AAA titles or complex game worlds 
    • Proficiency in 3D tools such as Blender or Maya to support concept workflows 
      • Experience contributing to cross-project or discipline-level improvements in workflows, standards, or practices 
        • Ability to work effectively across a range of artistic styles 
          • Experience supporting planning, resourcing, or project setup 
            • Experience contributing to recruitment, hiring, or team growth initiatives 

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU

You will work with talented and passionate people to support, develop or publish our sophisticated and enduring games, in a creative, collaborative and inclusive environment. We love what we do, and we work hard to provide outstanding experiences for our players. 

Wellbeing is a big focus at Frontier, and we are continually evolving how we can support our people. We encourage a healthy work/life balance and provide a range of wellbeing activities, initiatives and sessions to support both mental and physical health.  

We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, which includes a success-based annual bonus, share option schemes, life assurance, private family healthcare, flexitime working hours, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, in-house subsidised catering, support with relocation, a Cycle to Work scheme, free bike servicing, and social activities and events. 

We strive to create an environment where everyone can fully demonstrate their capability and potential. If you therefore need any reasonable adjustments to support you during the recruitment process, please speak to your Talent Acquisition representative.  

For queries, please email: -----

title: Senior Account Manager - Fulfil / Logistics
description: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <p><strong><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">About THG Ingenuity</span></strong></p> <p>THG Ingenuity is a fully integrated digital commerce ecosystem, designed to power brands without limits. Our global end-to-end tech platform is comprised of three products: THG Commerce, THG Studios, THG Fulfilment.&nbsp;</p> <p>Each represents a single, unified solution, overcoming challenges and taking brands direct-to-consumer. Our client portfolio includes globally recognised brands such as Coca-Cola, Nestle, Elemis, Homebase, and Proctor &amp; Gamble.</p></div><p>In this role you will be responsible for one of THG Fulfil's largest and most complex accounts, spanning B2B/channel and B2C/D2C fulfilment, inbound and new product introduction (NPI), value-added services, systems integration, and commercial administration, with direct exposure to both client leadership and THG group executives.</p> <h1><strong>The Role</strong></h1> <p>This is one of the most strategic, highest-visibility accounts in the Fulfil portfolio, and a newly created, dedicated role to match. It carries real intensity: a daily governance and reporting obligation, and a breadth of scope across B2B, B2C/D2C, inbound, NPI, VAS, integrations and commercial that effectively spans several workstreams under one relationship.</p> <p>With that comes genuine ownership. The successful candidate will be THG's primary point of contact for the client's operational, logistics and programme teams, translating their requirements into internal action across warehouse operations, transport, IT/integrations, ISC and commercial — and holding those teams to delivery. They will own the account's governance calendar and daily reporting, resolve escalations end-to-end, and hold credible technical conversations on integrations without needing to do that work personally. This is a role for someone who wants to run something significant, not administer it.</p> <h1><strong>Why This Role</strong></h1> <ul> <li><strong>Real seniority from day one:</strong>&nbsp;of one of Fulfil's largest and most complex accounts — you're the person in the room with senior leadership on both sides, not a supporting player.</li> <li><strong>A genuine growth track:</strong>&nbsp;this account and role are being created because the business is investing in getting its biggest relationships right; strong performance here is a natural springboard toward Account Director.</li> <li><strong>Influence, not just delivery:</strong>&nbsp;you'll shape governance, commercial terms and how internal teams organise around the account, rather than just following a playbook.</li> <li><strong>Depth over breadth:</strong>&nbsp;rather than spread thin across a portfolio, this is a rare chance to build deep, specialist expertise across the commercial, operational and technical sides of one major account.</li> </ul> <h1><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h1> <h2><strong>Client Relationship &amp; Day-to-Day Ownership</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Act as the primary THG point of contact</strong>&nbsp;for the client's operational, logistics and programme teams, including their EMEA fulfilment, transportation, global service &amp; logistics and extended workforce (xWF) partners.</li> <li><strong>Run a weekly 1:1 with the client account lead,</strong>&nbsp;plus regular ad hoc syncs with programme and technical contacts, translating requirements into internal actions across warehouse operations, transport, IT/integrations, ISC and commercial — and holding those teams to delivery.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Governance &amp; Reporting</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Own the account's governance calendar,</strong>&nbsp;including MBRs, QBRs, daily hypercare calls, and weekly ops, VAS, D2C &amp; Inbound and PM check-in calls — a minimum of two hours of scheduled client contact every working day before reporting, escalation handling or project work.</li> <li><strong>Produce supporting evidence packs</strong>&nbsp;for dispute resolution, and supply data extracts on request.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Escalation &amp; Incident Management</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Own live, cross-functional escalations end-to-end,</strong>&nbsp;keeping internal teams coordinated and the client informed throughout.</li> <li><strong>Provide same-day resolution and communication</strong>&nbsp;to the client and THG executives, including outside standard hours when escalations land on weekends.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Systems &amp; Integration Oversight</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Maintain working fluency in EDI and integration concepts</strong>&nbsp;sufficient to triage issues and hold credible technical conversations with the client's technical teams, without doing the integration work personally.</li> <li><strong>Support ongoing platform and project work</strong>&nbsp;including THG portal development, Fulfil UI change requests, and client-specific ISC process fixes, demos and training.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Project &amp; Change Delivery</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead delivery of account-specific projects and programmes</strong>&nbsp;(e.g. VAS/device rework programmes, NPI set-up, dangerous-goods order flow, EMEA programme initiatives) working across warehouse, transport, IT and ISC.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Commercial Support</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead commercial alignment sessions</strong>&nbsp;on activity outside the standard rate card (e.g. non-SSCC handling, decant, space over-allocation, DG printing), providing the operational evidence base for commercial and compliance discussions.</li> </ul> <h1><strong>Requirements</strong></h1> <ul> <li><strong>Client-facing account management experience</strong>&nbsp;in third-party logistics or supply chain, ideally with enterprise technology or consumer electronics clients.</li> <li><strong>Strong data and reporting capability</strong>&nbsp;— able to build compliance and performance reporting from raw operational data without analyst support.</li> <li><strong>Working understanding of EDI and integration concepts</strong>&nbsp;(945s, SSCC, IMEI and serialised stock, ASN flows) sufficient to triage issues and hold a credible technical conversation.</li> <li><strong>Confident operating at executive level</strong>&nbsp;on both sides of the relationship, including under escalation.</li> <li><strong>Able to influence internal operational teams without direct line authority</strong>&nbsp;across warehouse, transport, IT, ISC and commercial teams.</li> <li><strong>Resilience and availability —</strong>&nbsp;this account generates genuine out-of-hours and weekend demand during live escalations.</li> <li><strong>Proven ability to manage a high-volume governance calendar</strong>&nbsp;(ten or more recurring meetings per week) alongside reactive escalation and project work.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>THG Ingenuity is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.</strong></p> <p><strong>THG Ingenuity is committed to creating a diverse &amp; inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.</strong></p> <p><strong>Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG Ingenuity please contact one of our <span class="mark75xs2u5gf" data-markjs="true" data-ogac="" data-ogab="" data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="">Talent</span> team to discuss further.</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Principal HR Business Partner
description: <h3><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About Behavox:</strong></span></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Behavox is shaping the future for how businesses harness their most important raw material - data. Our mission is bold: Organize enterprise data into actionable information that protects and promotes the business growth of multinational companies around the world.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">From managing enterprise risk and compliance to maximizing revenue and value, our data operating platform presents a widespread opportunity to build multilingual, AI/ML-based solutions that activate data for every function within a global enterprise.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Our approach is unique, and it’s validated by our customers who tell us to keep forging ahead because no one else is aggregating, analyzing, and acting on data to uncover opportunities or solve problems quite the way we are.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">We are looking for fearless innovators who have an insatiable appetite for building what no one has built before. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">This is a hybrid role with 1 day in the office.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About the Role:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The Principal HR Business Partner is a senior individual contributor responsible for partnering with business leaders to execute people strategies that enable organizational performance, scalability, and sustainable growth. The role applies deep business acumen and HR expertise to advise leaders on organizational design, workforce planning, talent management, employee relations, and organizational effectiveness, ensuring people practices support evolving business priorities.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the Principal HR Business Partner independently partners with senior leaders to deliver enterprise people initiatives while ensuring alignment with global frameworks and applicable local employment requirements. The role leads workforce planning, organizational design, post-merger workforce integration, and enterprise change initiatives. It independently manages complex employee relations matters, provides expert guidance on organizational and people-related challenges, leverages workforce analytics to inform decision-making, and implements scalable people programs that strengthen organizational capability and business performance.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong><span data-sheets-root="1">What You'll Bring:</span></strong></span></p> <ol> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Strategic Human Resources Business Partnering</strong> — Applies deep understanding of business strategy, organizational priorities, and workforce needs to align people initiatives with business objectives and provide trusted advisory support to senior leaders.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Organizational Design and Workforce Planning</strong> — Owns the application of organizational design principles, workforce planning methodologies, and operating model changes to support business growth, organizational evolution, and business effectiveness.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Employment Law and Employee Relations</strong> — Maintains expert knowledge of employment legislation and regulatory frameworks, independently managing complex employee relations matters while mitigating organizational risk.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Talent Management and Organizational Development</strong> — Applies expertise in performance management, career development, succession planning, leadership enablement, and organizational capability development to strengthen business performance.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>People Analytics and Organizational Change</strong> — Uses workforce metrics, organizational data, and change management principles to evaluate people outcomes, support organizational transformation, and drive evidence-based decision-making.</span></li> </ol> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong><span data-sheets-root="1">What You'll Do:</span></strong></span></p> <ol> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Strategic HR Advisory</strong> — Independently provides expert HR guidance on complex organizational, workforce, and talent challenges, influencing business decisions through commercially informed, pragmatic recommendations.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Post-Merger Workforce Integration</strong> — Leads the people integration activities following mergers and acquisitions, including organizational alignment, role mapping, policy harmonization, and change implementation, ensuring a consistent employee experience, regulatory compliance, and business continuity.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Employee Relations Management</strong> — Owns the resolution of sensitive and high-complexity employee relations matters, balancing legal compliance, business priorities, and employee experience while appropriately managing organizational risk.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Scalable People Program Delivery</strong> — Designs, implements, and continuously improves HR programs across performance management, workforce planning, career development, and organizational effectiveness, ensuring consistency with enterprise standards and business needs.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Workforce Analytics and Organizational Insights</strong> — Interprets workforce data and people metrics to identify trends, evaluate program effectiveness, and provide actionable recommendations that improve organizational performance and people outcomes.</span></li> </ol> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong><span data-sheets-root="1">What We Offer</span></strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The opportunity to work on a global, mission-critical AI platform alongside the best engineers and technologists across multiple geographies</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">A role with real ownership and impact, building complex systems at scale in an environment that values speed, experimentation, and technical excellence</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">A highly attractive benefits package, including competitive cash compensation, an equity award aligned with long-term value creation, and comprehensive health insurance for employees and their families</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Modern, comfortable offices in Montreal/Toronto downtown, with an expectation of (hybrid) working from the office 1 day per week, reflecting our belief in strong in-person collaboration.&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">A generous time-off policy of 30 days annually, plus public holidays and sick leave, recognizing the importance of sustained high performance</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong><span data-sheets-root="1">About Our Process</span></strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We take Talent very seriously and we are building a community of extraordinary individuals working together in very high performing teams. We also know that the best Talent always has options so we believe that the process has to be a two way assessment - the company AND the candidate assessing the business needs alignment, the career next step alignment, and the cultural alignment.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">During the process we will begin by exploring the core factors regarding salary and location along with core experience and skills and values alignment. We will then deep dive explore the critical technical competencies we have identified for the role, and then we will deep dive in behavioral competencies.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The most aligned candidate will then be asked to do a practical work task simulation activity so we can make sure that you will enjoy the kind of work the role requires, and this task will typically be presented and discussed with a group of colleagues and managers. Finally we will ask you to meet with a number of our senior leaders to make sure that you are making the most informed call possible.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong><span data-sheets-root="1">Please note that:</span></strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;" data-sheets-root="1">We want to get to know you and have a genuine conversation, so the use of AI tools or assistance during live interviews is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate disqualification from the process.&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Interviews may be recorded&nbsp;for internal review purposes to ensure fairness and enable collaborative hiring discussions within the team.</span></li> </ul> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members: 900,000 UK and 1,100,000 in India and growing rapidly</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>Over 2,800 Tideans globally</li> <li>Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h3><strong>ABOUT THE TEAM:</strong></h3> <p>Ongoing Monitoring is building the capabilities Tide needs to detect, prevent and manage financial crime, fraud and risk across the member lifecycle.</p> <p>Within Ongoing Monitoring, we are creating a new Acquiring Fraud &amp; Risk team as part of the Ongoing Monitoring team. This team will focus on protecting Tide’s growing Merchant Acquiring business by reducing acquiring fraud, chargeback losses and operational risk across card-present and card-not-present payment journeys.</p> <p>Merchant Acquiring is a fast-growing product within Tide. title: Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic is building the Applied AI team to help the world's most ambitious organizations adopt Claude in ways that are transformative, safe, and lasting. Our Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with strategic customers to ship production AI applications that solve real business problems. As this practice grows, we need a founding leader to build and scale it.</p> <p>As the first FDE Manager, you'll own the team that sits at the frontier of enterprise AI deployment. You'll hire and develop a high-performing team of FDEs, set the technical and operational bar for customer engagements, and build the playbooks that turn one-off successes into repeatable patterns. You'll work hand-in-hand with Engagement Managers who own delivery logistics and stakeholder management, while you ensure your team is shipping quality code, growing technically, and representing Anthropic at the highest level in customer environments.</p> <p>This is a player-coach role with a strong bias toward leadership. You'll stay close enough to the technical work to review architectures, debug production issues, and pair with your team when it matters — but your primary impact will come from the people you hire, the standards you set, and the culture you create. You'll partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Engineering to shape how Anthropic serves its most strategic customers, and your team's field insights will directly influence product direction.</p> <p>This role requires someone who thrives in ambiguity and is energized by building from zero to one. You'll be defining what good looks like for FDE management at Anthropic — there is no existing playbook to follow.</p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li> <p>Hire, develop, and retain a world-class team of Forward Deployed Engineers. Set a high bar for technical talent and customer instincts.</p> </li> <li> <p>Conduct regular 1:1s, provide technical mentorship, and invest in the career growth of each team member. Create an environment where FDEs do the best work of their careers.</p> </li> <li> <p>Staff and oversee customer engagements across your team's portfolio, making resource allocation decisions that balance customer needs, team development, and business priorities.</p> </li> <li> <p>Collaborate with account teams and Engagement Managers during the pre-sales process to qualify engagements, scope work, and inform statements of work.</p> </li> <li> <p>Review technical architectures and code produced by your FDEs, ensuring the team ships high-quality, production-ready solutions that solve real customer problems.</p> </li> <li> <p>Stay hands-on enough to lead technical discovery sessions, prototype solutions, and debug complex issues alongside your team when needed.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build repeatable playbooks, starter repositories, integration templates, and an internal knowledge base that captures what your team learns in the field.</p> </li> <li> <p>Define team OKRs that tie to customer success outcomes and product adoption goals. Create operational cadences — standups, retros, engagement reviews — that keep the team aligned.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with Product and Engineering to translate field insights into product improvements. Serve as the voice of the customer in internal planning.</p> </li> <li> <p>Travel to customer sites as needed (25-50%), particularly during engagement kickoffs and for your team's highest-priority accounts.</p> </li> </ul> <h2><strong>You may be a good fit if you have</strong></h2> <ul> <li> <p>10+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, or a technical customer-facing role such as forward deployed engineering or consulting.</p> </li> <li> <p>2+ years of people management experience within a services/post-sales/FDE organization with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building organizations from 0-&gt;1,&nbsp;not just inheriting an existing one.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience working directly with enterprise customers on technical implementations, including comfort navigating complex organizational dynamics.</p> </li> <li> <p>Executive presence with the ability to move fluidly between strategic conversations with senior stakeholders and hands-on debugging sessions with engineers.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong written and verbal communication skills. You can translate technical complexity into clear narratives for diverse audiences.</p> </li> <li> <p>Genuine excitement about building something new and defining what great looks like for a team that doesn't yet exist.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Why this role matters</h2> <p>You'll be a founding leader of a team that defines how enterprises adopt and scale AI. Your work will directly influence Anthropic's product direction, create reusable patterns for the broader customer base, and establish Anthropic as the trusted partner for AI transformation — all while advancing the responsible development of frontier AI systems.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.&nbsp;</p> <p>For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.</p></div><div class="title">Annual Salary:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£1</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£1 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <p><strong>Minimum education: </strong>Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience</p> <p><strong>Required field of study:&nbsp;</strong>A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience</p> <p><strong>Minimum years of experience: </strong>Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position</p> <p><strong>Location-based hybrid policy:</strong> Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Visa sponsorship:</strong>&nbsp;We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.</p> <p><strong>We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.</strong> Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.&nbsp; Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.<br><br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Your safety matters to us.</strong> To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit&nbsp;<u data-stringify-type="underline"><a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="http://anthropic.com/careers" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://anthropic.com/careers" data-sk="tooltip_parent" data-remove-tab-index="true">anthropic.com/careers</a></u>&nbsp;directly for confirmed position openings.</p> <h2><strong>How we're different</strong></h2> <p>We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.</p> <p>The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI &amp; Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.</p> <h2><strong>Come work with us!</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. <strong data-stringify-type="bold">Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:</strong>&nbsp;Learn about&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" data-sk="tooltip_parent">our policy</a> for using AI in our application process.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who we are&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.<br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></p> <p><strong>Hiring and how we work</strong></p> <p>We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!&nbsp;</p> <p>Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.&nbsp;<br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></p></div><p><strong>See yourself at Twilio</strong></p> <p>Join the team as Twilio’s next Senior Telecom Billing Specialist.</p> <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>This position will be responsible for working constructively with our customers and partners to resolve billing issues and fraudulent misuse of services.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are seeking a sharp, highly data-oriented, and tenacious Telecom Billing Specialist to join our team. Unlike a traditional billing or collections role focused on routine outreach or simple invoice review, this position is a hybrid of financial investigation, root cause analysis, and strategic dispute negotiation.&nbsp; In this role, you will look for billing discrepancies, investigate Artificially Inflated Traffic (AIT) or IRSF (International Revenue Share Fraud), dig deep into messaging and call data, project manage high-value customer and vendor disputes, and build data-backed cases to resolve discrepancies. You will build dashboards to communicate key metrics and drive action. If you love solving complex data puzzles, negotiating with external parties, and finding win-win outcomes, this is the role for you.</p> <p>You will be part of a company that is the category leader in Communications Platform as a Service (CPaaS), an organization working with the largest customers and partners, and a team of operators and former consultants that have delivered exceptional impact. Twilio values diverse experiences in other industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. While having “desired” qualifications make for a strong candidate, we encourage applicants with alternative experiences to also apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!</p> <p><strong>Required:</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of professional experience in telecom billing, revenue assurance, wholesale SMS billing settlements, and/or CPaaS fraud operations.</li> <li>Sharp written and verbal communication skills.</li> <li>Experience negotiating disputes constructively with customers or vendors.</li> <li>Experience in collections, dispute resolution, or billing analysis.</li> <li>Experience in project management.</li> <li>Experience wrangling data with Excel / Google Sheets, Looker or SQL.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desired:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Understanding of the A2P SMS ecosystem, international traffic routing, international revenue share fraud (IRSF), artificially inflated traffic (AIT) and the ecosystem profit chains.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Understanding of industry standards with respect to AIT and fraud handling such as frameworks from i3forum, GSMA, MEF or ITW Global Leaders’ Forum.</li> <li>Understanding of Call Detail Records (CDRs) and ability to build strong dispute case files.</li> <li>Experience working with workflow platforms like Airtable or building dashboards.</li> <li>Experience in telecom, technology, or consulting industries.</li> <li>Experience with advanced data analysis like Python or scripting</li> <li>Experience with AI and automation tools to accelerate productivity.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Location</strong></p> <p>This role will be remote and based in the UK, Ireland or Estonia.</p> <p><strong>Travel&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.</p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Twilio thinks big. Do you?</strong></p> <p>We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/values">Twilio Magic</a>. Additionally, we empower employees to build <a href="https://twilio.org/support-and-resources/impact-fund">positive change in their communities</a> by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.</p> <p>So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/jobs#open-positions">please consider other open positions.</a></p> <p><strong><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></strong></p> <p><strong>Stay alert to recruitment fraud</strong></p> <p>We care about your safety. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @<a href="http://twilio.com">twilio.com</a> email address. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.<br><br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.</strong> We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. title: Senior Strategy & Ops Manager - New Verticles
description: About us We are champions of rail, inspired to build a greener, more sustainable future of travel. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 Now Europe’s number 1 downloaded rail app, with over 135 million monthly visits and £6.3 billion in annual ticket sales, we collaborate with 270+ rail and coach companies in over 40 countries. We want to create a world where travel is as simple, seamless, eco-friendly and affordable as it should be. Today, we're a FTSE 250 company driven by our incredible team of over 1,000 Trainliners from 50+ nationalities, based across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. With our focus on growth in the UK and Europe, now is the perfect time to join us on this high-speed journey. Introducing the Trainline New Verticals Team 👋 New Verticals is one of Trainline's largest growth bets, building and scaling our Hotels and Car Hire businesses. The team is moving fast: standing up new partnerships, launching new product experiences, and setting the operating model that will grow this into a meaningful part of Trainline over the next few years. We're looking for a Senior Manager to be the strategic and operational backbone of this build, working directly with the Head of New Verticals and cross-functional stakeholders to turn ambition into a disciplined, well-run programme. This is a high-visibility role for someone comfortable structuring a loosely defined problem, bringing a point of view to the table, and combining strong execution with a keen eye for detail. You'll co-create strategy alongside Product, Commercial and Legal leads, working closely with multiple cross-functional teams to keep complex, multi-party launches on track, translate strategy into executable plans, and ensure nothing important falls through the cracks. In this role as the Senior Manager, Strategy & Operations, you will...🚄 · Shape the New Verticals strategy across Hotels and Cars, translating it into structured roadmaps, milestones and success metrics · Bring structured thinking to ambiguous, fast-evolving problems and anticipate risks and dependencies before they become blockers · Own the end-to-end programme across major New Verticals initiatives, including new product launches and feature rollouts · Track dependencies, risks and decisions across cross-functional partners, driving them to resolution · Build and run the governance rhythm for the New Verticals programme, ensuring the right people have the right information at the right time · Own leadership reporting, including performance updates, business reviews and steering committee materials, synthesising complex detail into clear, decision-ready narratives · Act as a trusted connective layer between New Verticals and partners including Legal, Compliance, Finance, Product, Design and Commercial · Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders, influencing without formal authority and getting ahead of cross-team friction We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍 · Strong programme or project management experience, ideally including complex, multi-stakeholder launches · A structured, analytical approach, comfortable building plans, frameworks and reporting from scratch · Executive presence and communication range, equally credible presenting to a steering committee or debating in a working session · Strong stakeholder management skills, with the credibility to work confidently with and influence senior leaders · A bias to action, spotting what needs to happen and driving it rather than waiting to be told · Comfort with ambiguity, energised by building things from the ground up rather than following an existing playbook · Experience in hotels, travel or the broader travel-tech/OTA space is helpful but not required; what matters most is the operating rigour, judgement and strategic instinct you bring What this role offers you... This is about as close as you'll get to setting up and running your own business: · Seat at the table early. Direct exposure to senior leadership and C-suite as you help shape a business that's still being written, not one you're inheriting · The full arc of business building, from strategy through to launch and beyond, with a real P&L to show for it, backed by the resources and stability of an established, publicly listed company · Steep learning curve. You'll pick up foundational skills across Strategy, Product, Commercial, Ops and more · Launchpad for what's next. New Verticals has genuinely aggressive growth ambitions across new lines of business, and you'll be positioned to grow with it. · Great team and work culture. Genuinely friendly people who'll always have your back! More information: Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy. Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 🤝 Travel Together - We're one team ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated. Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn , Instagram and Glassdoor ! As a fast moving FTSE 250 business, we're looking for an experienced and technically excellent Head of Group Reporting to join us for a 6 month contract.   • Own the Group's cashflow forecasting process, providing insight and analysis on liquidity, capital allocation and capital structure to support CFO and Board decision making, working closely with treasury on execution.

  • Build and support strong external relationships, including with auditors, loan providers and banking partners, and work closely with legal and CoSec to ensure reporting requirements are met on time.

  • Lead Finance's contribution to the Group's material controls framework under Provision 29, maintain and develop the Group's accounting policies including for acquisitions and legal structure changes, and guide reporting systems and process change to protect the integrity of our control environment.

  • You're a qualified accountant with significant post qualification experience, including meaningful time spent in industry within a listed business, and are comfortable with the reporting obligations and scrutiny that come with that environment; you have a consistent record of delivering to deadline.

  • You bring extensive IFRS expertise and a strong technical accounting grounding, confident researching and forming defensible positions on complex areas such as multi-currency consolidations, share based payments, EPS, impairment, revenue recognition, leases and business combinations.

  • You're analytical and thorough when reviewing financial information, quick to spot errors in accounting treatment or anomalies that don't add up.

We're an ambitious team of 150+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

The role

We're looking for a Principal Engineer to join our Foundations team, the backend backbone that builds the reliable, scalable, fast systems everyone else at Encord builds on top of. The team's core challenges sit deep in distributed and data intensive systems.

The product mindset on this team is different from most of the company: short-term product insight matters less, long-term matters a lot. Our Foundations team plans around how the next 6, 12, and 24 months will look, with an overarching shape to the problem: handling multiple orders of magnitude the data we handle today. This is our most senior individual contributor role. You'll own the hardest architectural calls, make the trade-offs that shape the platform for years, and raise the engineering bar across the company.

Encord is growing rapidly, with our product as the key driver of that growth. A year ago, we were a team of 100, now, we're over 150 and continuing to accelerate. The systems that got us here won't get us to what's next. That's the problem you'll own.

What you'll do

  • Design and lead major database and processing-system initiatives

  • Design performant protocols and APIs, such as our label-format API, that customers use directly. This work sits across both product and engineering

  • Build robust distributed systems and reason rigorously about how they fail and how they behave under load

  • Level up engineers across the company through design reviews, pairing, and mentorship, without adding process for its own sake

Who we're looking for

  • You've seen and built more than most. You've personally designed, built, and operated large-scale distributed systems in production, and you've lived with your architectural decisions long enough to know which trade-offs actually matter

  • Your impact shows up in the output of the engineers around you, not just your own commits. You make hard things look simple and teach others to do the same

  • You want your work to have a tangible outcome for people. You're not satisfied with building products that do not see the light of day

  • You are a builder. You enjoy all aspects of building not only software but a complete product, and are comfortable moving across the stack when necessary

  • You enjoy problem-solving and thinking from first principles, reach for the simplest solution that works, and know when boring technology wins

  • You're happy to own problems without a predefined, clear definition or obvious solution, and are excited to have autonomy to make decisions as you go

  • You understand that being a member of a high-performing team requires two things. You contribute your best work and help others contribute their best. You'll always lend a helping hand when needed and level up those around you

Experience requirements

  • 10+ years building large-scale backend infrastructure applications, including several years operating at staff/principal level with company-wide technical influence

  • Deep expertise in distributed systems (databases, processing systems, replication, partitioning, queuing, caching) and a rigorous understanding of how they fail and behave under load at scale

  • Experience leading large-scale data migrations and system-splitting or re-architecture projects with real customer data on the line

  • Experience owning reliability and operations in production, including monitoring, alerting, and DevOps/SRE

  • A track record of raising engineering quality across teams through architecture reviews, code reviews, testing, rollout, and monitoring practices

  • Demonstrated ability to influence without authority, driving technical alignment across teams in a fast-moving, low-process environment

Tech stack

We are technology-agnostic at Encord and are not looking for experience across all of these. As long as you're open to learning, please apply.

  • Backend: Python

  • Frontend: TypeScript and React

  • Deployment: Kubernetes

  • Infrastructure: GCP

  • Machine learning: PyTorch, CUDA, Ray

Why Encord

  • Competitive salary, commission, and meaningful equity in a high-growth startup

  • Strong in-person culture: the team works from our London office 4+ days/week

  • 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe

  • Company lunches twice a week

  • Monthly socials & bi-annual team offsites
